hypotheses_declared_before_any_fit.status: HS-Stroke discovery cohort; the TS+LR LEAKED / PLACEBO outcomes on these arms are known (R4; reproduced in R7-C7; L - P +2.25 BA on seeds 42-44); R9-C's EEGNet decomposition on the identical halves is known (C1 +12.18, C2 +1.27 BA). The TS+LR split arms L1 / L2 have never been fitted, so C1-C3 below are new outcomes.
hypotheses_declared_before_any_fit.question: Is the linear decoder's benchmark inflation also mostly own-copy exposure? R4's conditional learning-curve bound attributed up to 42 % (S1) / 51 % (S2) of TS+LR inflation to support, against 13 % for EEGNet in R8-B; both bounds rest on premises that fail (R9-C audit). This experiment replaces the TS+LR bound by randomisation.
hypotheses_declared_before_any_fit.C1: exposure with support fixed: BA of exposed scored trials in their own-exposed half arm minus the other-half arm > 0
hypotheses_declared_before_any_fit.C2: support of half the test-trial copies (same runs, no own copy): other-half arm minus PLACEBO != 0 (two-sided)
hypotheses_declared_before_any_fit.C3: exposure exceeds that support at equal distinct-trial count: C1 - C2 > 0
hypotheses_declared_before_any_fit.descriptive: as R9-C: absolute BA; total half = own - P; support share = C2 / total (ratio of cohort means); full L - P on exposed / all / unexposed scored trials; full - total half; support of a half for unexposed trials; probability-scale versions. In addition: the side-by-side EEGNet values from the committed R9-C aggregate (descriptive; no cross-decoder test is declared)
hypotheses_declared_before_any_fit.interpretation_rule: identified at HALF exposure density only (as R9-C). Whatever the outcome, the manuscript reports the TS+LR and EEGNet decompositions side by side and states any benchmark-level exposure claim per decoder; R4's TS+LR learning-curve bound is reported only as a historical, conditional figure
hypotheses_declared_before_any_fit.no_SESOI: no equivalence region and no post-hoc relevance threshold; all results reported whatever their sign

design.arms: R4 frozen G2 manifest LEAKED (L) and PLACEBO (P); L1 / L2 and the halves H1 / H2 constructed exactly as R9-C (split_bench, RNG default_rng([9201, seed, participant, fold])); identical plan commitment to R9-C
design.model: frozen vendored R4 TSLRw through R7-C7's fit function c7._r4: per-arm multiplicity-weighted Karcher reference, tangent map, sklearn lbfgs L2-LR (C = 1), R4's single-class rule; single-thread BLAS; deterministic
design.checks: fail closed: split invariants (as R9-C); finite outputs; A/A independent refit of L on every 10th fold (R9-C's global order) must be exactly equal; L and P must reproduce R7-C7's stored S2 seed 42-44 probabilities and hard decisions bit for bit (max |dp| = 0, agreement = 1)
design.unit: participant (14): class-balanced BA pooled over a participant's exposed scored trials per seed, mean over seeds 42-44 (split_analysis, unchanged from R9-C); exact sign-flip (2^14), Holm over C1-C3
